TABLE.NAME: local_oksigeniaeguahe_centre
TABLE.COMMENT: A centre that receives families: a school, an academy, a college. Every other table carries its id

FIELD.NAME: name
FIELD.COMMENT: The name families know

FIELD.NAME: lang
FIELD.COMMENT: Language of the centre, used when a family's is not offered

FIELD.NAME: country
FIELD.COMMENT: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2, for phone numbers given without their country code

FIELD.NAME: currency
FIELD.COMMENT: ISO 4217, for what the centre spends; empty, the one of its country

FIELD.NAME: system
FIELD.COMMENT: Its school system, a key of data/school-systems.json; none, no system; empty, the one of its country

FIELD.NAME: aion
FIELD.COMMENT: Whether the AI of the site works for this centre; only who manages Eguahe on the site turns it on

FIELD.NAME: shareinvite
FIELD.COMMENT: Whether what a family shares invites whoever receives it to know the centre

FIELD.NAME: shareentry
FIELD.COMMENT: The form the invitation leads to; 0, the first one active

FIELD.NAME: colour
FIELD.COMMENT: Main colour of the centre for its public pages, #rrggbb

FIELD.NAME: controller
FIELD.COMMENT: Who is responsible for the data of the families: the legal name of the centre

FIELD.NAME: rightscontact
FIELD.COMMENT: Where families exercise their rights: an address or an email

FIELD.NAME: dpocontact
FIELD.COMMENT: The data protection officer, if the centre has one

FIELD.NAME: retention
FIELD.COMMENT: Months the data of a family without activity is kept

FIELD.NAME: municipalities
FIELD.COMMENT: The area of the centre, one per line: official code;name

FIELD.NAME: aiprovider
FIELD.COMMENT: The AI provider instance of the centre; 0 for none

FIELD.NAME: address
FIELD.COMMENT: Where the centre is, for the families

FIELD.NAME: phone
FIELD.COMMENT: The phone families call

FIELD.NAME: email
FIELD.COMMENT: The address families write to

FIELD.NAME: welcome
FIELD.COMMENT: What a visit is like, in a line, for the page of signing up

FIELD.NAME: logoplate
FIELD.COMMENT: 1 when the logo needs a light plate in dark mode

FIELD.NAME: messaging
FIELD.COMMENT: Telegram and WhatsApp with Marandu: off, notices or conversation

FIELD.NAME: skin
FIELD.COMMENT: The skin of the panel of the team: vestibulo, mostrador or cinematico; null, the one its offer suggests

FIELD.NAME: arrive
FIELD.COMMENT: How families get in on the day: the door, whom they give their name to

FIELD.NAME: campaignstart
FIELD.COMMENT: When the campaign of admissions under way started, as the centre wrote it; 0 if it did not

FIELD.NAME: labelsheets
FIELD.COMMENT: The sheets of labels of the centre: its favourites of each kind and how much its printer moves each, JSON

FIELD.NAME: replydays
FIELD.COMMENT: Working days the team usually takes to answer a family, as the families read it

FIELD.NAME: library
FIELD.COMMENT: The library of Ayvurenda whose stories to read at home the families get, by its slug

FIELD.NAME: handover
FIELD.COMMENT: The member of the team who carries the families once enrolled; 0, a place or nobody

FIELD.NAME: handoverplace
FIELD.COMMENT: Where the families are carried once enrolled when nobody is named: the office of students and its phone

FIELD.NAME: handoverhow
FIELD.COMMENT: How the centre writes to the families once enrolled, as they read it

FIELD.NAME: siblingage
FIELD.COMMENT: The age children enter at, to tell a family the year before a brother or sister turns it; 0, children do not enter by age here

FIELD.NAME: invitegone
FIELD.COMMENT: 1 when the families that left are still invited to open acts; 0, they are left in peace

FIELD.NAME: networks
FIELD.COMMENT: The networks a family may name when it heard of the centre on one, one per line, as the centre writes them; empty, the usual ones

FIELD.NAME: channelauto
FIELD.COMMENT: The moments of each open act that go by themselves to the channel of Telegram, comma separated (announce, tell, last, day); null, the announcement only

FIELD.NAME: renewalyear
FIELD.COMMENT: The school year the families of the centre are asked whether their children go on into; null, not asked

FIELD.NAME: renewalfrom
FIELD.COMMENT: From when the families can answer

FIELD.NAME: renewaluntil
FIELD.COMMENT: Until when, the start of the day after the last one; 0, no end

FIELD.NAME: rostersource
FIELD.COMMENT: Where the course of each student of the common family record comes from: cohort, group:courseid or profile:shortname; null, the families already at the centre are not brought

FIELD.NAME: rosteryear
FIELD.COMMENT: The school year the students of the centre are in now, whose courses they are placed in

FIELD.NAME: firstday
FIELD.COMMENT: The first day of the next school year, for the story of the children who start; 0, not written

FIELD.NAME: namephrase
FIELD.COMMENT: The name of the centre as it is said in a sentence, with its article if it has one

FIELD.NAME: applyhow
FIELD.COMMENT: How a family asks for a place, as the centre writes it, for the page of each family after its visit

FIELD.NAME: applyurl
FIELD.COMMENT: Where a place is asked for, when it is on a website

FIELD.NAME: applyfrom
FIELD.COMMENT: The first day a place can be asked for; 0, not written

FIELD.NAME: applyuntil
FIELD.COMMENT: The last day a place can be asked for; 0, not written

FIELD.NAME: costs
FIELD.COMMENT: What it all costs, as the centre writes it: a line per thing, «what: how much»

FIELD.NAME: costswhen
FIELD.COMMENT: When families see what it costs: start, after the visit, or never

FIELD.NAME: familyfrom
FIELD.COMMENT: Who puts an enrolled family in the common family record: eguahe, or records (the management system of the centre loads it, and a person joins it)

FIELD.NAME: guide
FIELD.COMMENT: The guide on the pages of the families (guide::KINDS), or null for none

FIELD.NAME: guidewhere
FIELD.COMMENT: Where the guide takes families on the miniature, as the centre writes it

FIELD.NAME: guidehello
FIELD.COMMENT: What the guide says by the greeting, as the centre writes it; empty, the words of Eguahe

TABLE.NAME: local_oksigeniaeguahe_member
TABLE.COMMENT: Who works for a centre: the people of its team

FIELD.NAME: public
FIELD.COMMENT: 1 when families see this person, with photo, role and a line

FIELD.NAME: rolename
FIELD.COMMENT: What this person does, as families read it

FIELD.NAME: says
FIELD.COMMENT: A line of this person to the families

FIELD.NAME: awayuntil
FIELD.COMMENT: Until when this person is away: their families and promises are for everyone; 0, here

TABLE.NAME: local_oksigeniaeguahe_offer
TABLE.COMMENT: What a centre offers in a school year, as it names it (a grade, a course), with its places

FIELD.NAME: schoolyear
FIELD.COMMENT: The school year it is for: 2027-28, or 2027 where the year is a calendar year

FIELD.NAME: places
FIELD.COMMENT: Places for new students; 0 when not counted

FIELD.NAME: active
FIELD.COMMENT: Shown to families in the forms

FIELD.NAME: handover
FIELD.COMMENT: The member of the team who carries the families of this course once enrolled (its tutor); 0, the one of the centre

FIELD.NAME: story
FIELD.COMMENT: Whether the children of this course get the story of the first day; empty, the first years at school

FIELD.NAME: teacher
FIELD.COMMENT: How the story calls whoever receives this course: maestra or maestro

FIELD.NAME: firstday
FIELD.COMMENT: The first day of this course in its school year, the start of the day; 0, the general one of the centre

FIELD.NAME: firstdayok
FIELD.COMMENT: When a person last wrote or confirmed the first day of this course

FIELD.NAME: nextname
FIELD.COMMENT: The course its pupils go on to next school year, by name, when its age does not say it (vocational training, academies); a dash, none: they finish here

TABLE.NAME: local_oksigeniaeguahe_household
TABLE.COMMENT: A household that asks for information or a place: the unit that decides

FIELD.NAME: lang
FIELD.COMMENT: The language the household writes in

FIELD.NAME: municipality
FIELD.COMMENT: Official code of the municipality, when known

FIELD.NAME: moving
FIELD.COMMENT: 1 when the family lives outside the area and is moving to it

FIELD.NAME: ownerid
FIELD.COMMENT: The person of the team who attends the family; 0, nobody yet

FIELD.NAME: heardfrom
FIELD.COMMENT: How the household heard of the centre, as they said it (a closed list)

FIELD.NAME: firstchannel
FIELD.COMMENT: Where the first contact came from

FIELD.NAME: incentre
FIELD.COMMENT: Already a family of the centre: out of the numbers of the campaign

FIELD.NAME: linkhash
FIELD.COMMENT: SHA-256 of the private link of the household; never the link itself

FIELD.NAME: waitingsince
FIELD.COMMENT: Since when the household waits for a person to answer; 0 when nobody is owed an answer

FIELD.NAME: volunteer
FIELD.COMMENT: When the family said yes to telling another family how it went; 0, they did not

FIELD.NAME: heardwho
FIELD.COMMENT: Which family of the centre told them about it, if they said so; never a link between households

FIELD.NAME: thanked
FIELD.COMMENT: When the team thanked the family that told them about the centre; 0, not yet

FIELD.NAME: heardnet
FIELD.COMMENT: Which network, when they heard of the centre on one, as the family named it

FIELD.NAME: invitesign
FIELD.COMMENT: How an ambassador family signs its invitation to other families, as it wrote it; empty, a family of the centre

FIELD.NAME: familylink
FIELD.COMMENT: The family of the centre (local_oksigeniafamily) a person said this household is; -1, said it is not; 0, not asked

FIELD.NAME: roster
FIELD.COMMENT: When it came from the roll of the centre (the common family record), already at the centre; 0, it came through Eguahe

FIELD.NAME: aisummary
FIELD.COMMENT: Where the family is, in two sentences of facts, as the AI of the centre last wrote it for the team; never a judgement

FIELD.NAME: aisummarytime
FIELD.COMMENT: When the summary was written

FIELD.NAME: whyother
FIELD.COMMENT: Why it chose another centre, if it said: the reasons it marked (whyother::REASONS), comma-separated

FIELD.NAME: whyothertime
FIELD.COMMENT: When it said why it chose another centre

TABLE.NAME: local_oksigeniaeguahe_adult
TABLE.COMMENT: An adult of a household, never a Moodle user

FIELD.NAME: email
FIELD.COMMENT: In lower case

FIELD.NAME: phone
FIELD.COMMENT: E.164, when it could be told

TABLE.NAME: local_oksigeniaeguahe_child
TABLE.COMMENT: A child of a household, the one who would study, with the offer asked for and how far the way has gone

FIELD.NAME: tagname
FIELD.COMMENT: The name used at home, written on the label of what the family gets; the first name when empty

FIELD.NAME: latinname
FIELD.COMMENT: Their name in Latin letters, when the family writes it in another script: what the voice of the story says

FIELD.NAME: birthdate
FIELD.COMMENT: The date of birth (YYYY-MM-DD), when the family gives it: their birthday

FIELD.NAME: offerid
FIELD.COMMENT: The offer asked for; 0 while unknown

FIELD.NAME: stage
FIELD.COMMENT: One of the stages of stages.php, each with its fixed definition

FIELD.NAME: closedreason
FIELD.COMMENT: Why the way stopped, when stage is closed

FIELD.NAME: started
FIELD.COMMENT: When the team marked on the first day that the child started; 0, not marked

FIELD.NAME: lefttime
FIELD.COMMENT: When an enrolled child left the centre, as the team noted it; 0, still there

FIELD.NAME: leftreason
FIELD.COMMENT: Why they left, from the short list: what Cifras counts

FIELD.NAME: leftnote
FIELD.COMMENT: A line from whoever heard it, to read

FIELD.NAME: familychild
FIELD.COMMENT: The child in the common family record (local_oksigeniafamily) once enrolled; 0, none

FIELD.NAME: familygone
FIELD.COMMENT: When the common family record said this child left, for a person to confirm; 0, it did not

FIELD.NAME: roster
FIELD.COMMENT: When it came from the roll of the centre (the common family record), already a student; 0, it came through Eguahe

FIELD.NAME: startyear
FIELD.COMMENT: The school year it started at the centre, once enrolled through Eguahe: what is only for new children (the story, the eve, the first day) is for that year

FIELD.NAME: place
FIELD.COMMENT: Where families go: an address or the door of the centre

FIELD.NAME: capacity

FIELD.NAME: token

FIELD.NAME: open

FIELD.COMMENT: 1 when the miniature of the centre shows where to park, for a big act
